prompt: Why could the operators not tell that their copies were obsolete?
promptZh: 作業員為何無法辨識手上的副本已失效？

options.text: The copies had no indication that they were obsolete
options.whyZh: 舊版指導書上沒有失效標示，作業員因此無法辨識。

options.text: Revision 3 had not yet been released
options.whyZh: 第三版已在一週前發行。

options.text: The instructions were written in an unknown language
options.zh: 指導書以作業員看不懂的語言撰寫。

options.text: The customer had approved revision 2 for all future use
options.zh: 客戶已核准今後一律使用第二版。
options.whyZh: 文件沒有說客戶核准繼續使用第二版；供應商的改善計畫反而要求換成第三版。

explanationZh: 舊版指導書上沒有失效標示，作業員因此無法辨識。
evidence: The old copies were unmarked, so the operators could not tell that they were obsolete.

vocabulary.note: 文件已由新版本取代，不可再當作現行作業依據。
針對已發現問題採取的改善行動。
